item.title: Amgen Tavneos Liver Injury
item.description:
• Summary: Amgen's drug Tavneos (avacopan) faces increased scrutiny over liver injury risks. Regulatory updates include a label modification in Japan, where the drug has been linked to 20 deaths. The safety concerns prompt a reevaluation of its benefit-risk profile for ANCA-associated vasculitis.
  • MoAs: Complement C5a receptor antagonist
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma, BioSpace

item.title: BioMarin Voxzogo Hypochondroplasia
item.description:
• Summary: BioMarin plans to file for regulatory approval of Voxzogo (vosoritide) in hypochondroplasia following positive trial results. The study met primary endpoints, demonstrating a larger-than-expected effect on linear growth, potentially expanding the drug's indication beyond achondroplasia.
  • MoAs: C-type natriuretic peptide (CNP) analog, stimulates growth plate activity
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma, BioPharma Dive, Endpoints News, BioSpace

item.title: Trikafta Cystic Fibrosis Long-Term Data
item.description:
• Summary: Long-term data presented at ATS 2026 demonstrated durable benefit of Trikafta (elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor) for cystic fibrosis patients. The results support sustained efficacy and safety over extended treatment duration.
  • MoAs: CFTR potentiator (ivacaftor) and correctors (elexacaftor, tezacaftor)
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology
